name: Hanoi food guide
summary: Pho in the Hoan Kiem lanes in the morning, bun cha at lunch around Cua Dong, and egg coffee in the afternoon in the Nguyen Huu Huan alley.
body: Vietnam Tourism ties those three to Hanoi, and it names shops on the same page. The shops are not picks here. The streets are.
Banh mi is not on that Hanoi list, so this guide does not add a Hanoi line for it. Bun dau, cha ca, and the other dishes on the list have no licensed plate photo, so they stay off the cards.
seoTitle: Hanoi food guide: pho, bun cha, and egg coffee
seoDescription: What Hanoi’s own dish page says to order: pho in the morning, bun cha at lunch, and egg coffee in the afternoon.
